jobs.description:
Ready for something new? Take your Norwegian language skills to Greece and let the next chapter of your career begin in the sunshine.
We are currently looking for Norwegian-speaking candidates for a variety of positions with one of Europe's largest international employers in customer service and digital services in Greece.
This is your opportunity to use your Norwegian language skills in your everyday work while gaining international experience and enjoying life in Greece.
Depending on your profile, interests, and available positions, you may be matched with different roles and projects.
Work with Well-Known International Brands
Our recruitment partner works with some of the world's most recognized companies and brands, including:
Netflix, Booking.com, Mercedes, Microsoft, PayPal, Dyson, Canon, Miele, Vattenfall, Singapore Airlines, Avis, JTI, Edenred, Scalable Capital, and Vinted.
The project you may be considered for will depend on your profile, experience, availability, and which Norwegian-speaking positions are open at the time of your application.
What Kind of Work Can You Do?
There are several types of opportunities available for Norwegian-speaking candidates, including:
Customer service via phone, chat, and email
Technical support
Digital services and online platforms
Sales and business development
Support within travel, streaming, finance, e-commerce, and technology
Other specialist roles depending on your background

Previous customer service experience is an advantage for many positions, but it is not required for every role.
You will receive training before starting your new position, allowing you to become familiar with the products and systems you will be working with.
Choose the Lifestyle That Suits You
Working arrangements vary depending on the project.
You may have the opportunity to work:
🏠 Remotely from Greece
Some projects offer fully remote positions, allowing you to work from home as long as you live in Greece.
🏢 From an Office in Athens
Experience life in a vibrant European capital with an international atmosphere, excellent restaurants, culture, and the sea nearby.
🌊 In Thessaloniki
Greece's second-largest city combines urban living with a beautiful waterfront, restaurants, and a thriving international community.
☀️ In Chania, Crete
Certain projects offer opportunities to work from Chania, where the sea, beaches, and the relaxed Cretan lifestyle are right on your doorstep.
Hybrid working arrangements are also available for certain positions.
Available locations and working arrangements depend on the specific project.
Moving to Greece Is Easier Than You Think
You don't have to organize your entire relocation on your own.
For many positions, a relocation package is included, offering:
✈️ Flight ticket to Greece
🚕 Airport transfer
🏨 Hotel accommodation upon arrival
🏠 Assistance with finding long-term housing
🤝 Support throughout the relocation process
This allows you to focus on your new job and life in Greece rather than having to arrange everything yourself before departure.
Who Are We Looking For?
We are looking for candidates who:
Speak and write fluent Norwegian

Have good English communication skills

Are service-minded and enjoy helping others

Are comfortable using computers and digital systems

Are solution-oriented and eager to learn

Are open to living and working in Greece

Extensive previous work experience is not required for many of these positions. Motivation, communication skills, and a positive attitude can be just as important.
One Application – Multiple Opportunities
You don't need to know exactly which project or position would suit you best before applying.
When you submit your application, your profile will be reviewed against the Norwegian-speaking positions currently available.
You may then move forward with the role that best matches your experience, preferences, and availability to start.
This also means you are welcome to apply if you are open to different types of jobs or locations across Greece.
Why Greece?
Working abroad doesn't have to be just a career move.
It can also mean:
☀️ A warmer climate and more time outdoors
🌊 Easy access to the sea and beautiful beaches
🌍 An international social environment
🇬🇷 The opportunity to explore Greece and its islands
💼 Valuable international experience for your CV
✈️ The chance to experience life abroad with relocation support
For some, it becomes a year in the sunshine. For others, it marks the beginning of an entirely new international career.
Apply Today
Are you a Norwegian speaker curious about the opportunities available to you in Greece?
Submit your application, and we'll match your profile with the positions currently available.
You don't need to choose a specific project, city, or position before applying.
Apply today and discover what opportunities are waiting for you in Greece!

jobs.occupation: Radiographer – Daytime position in coastal Sweden
jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
We are currently recruiting two radiographers for a smaller, well-functioning radiology department in coastal central Sweden.
This is a long-term opportunity for someone who values modern equipment, close teamwork and a healthy work-life balance, with daytime working hours and no evenings, nights, weekends or public holidays.
The department
The department is a smaller radiology unit with approximately 10 employees, providing both planned and acute diagnostic imaging in close collaboration with inpatient care and primary care.
The facilities have recently been modernised and the department works with new technology, including:
Canon CT
Samsung conventional X-ray
Ultrasound

The team consists of radiographers, assistant nurses, a radiologist and a sonographer.
There is also close collaboration with a larger radiology department, providing the opportunity to occasionally gain experience in a setting with a higher acute patient flow.
The role
The position includes standard duties as a radiographer, primarily within:
CT
Conventional radiography
Planned and acute examinations

You will work closely with radiographers, radiologists, assistant nurses and other healthcare professionals.
Working hours are Monday to Friday, 07:30–16:00. There are no evening or night shifts, no weekend work, no work on public holidays and no on-call duties.
Previous experience as a radiographer is an advantage but not a requirement. Experience with CT and conventional radiography is considered particularly valuable.
 
 
The location
The hospital is located in a smaller coastal community in central Sweden, with approximately 24,000 inhabitants in the local area.
The area combines small-town living with close access to the sea, lakes, countryside and an extensive archipelago. It is particularly well suited to those looking for a quieter lifestyle with good opportunities for outdoor activities and family life.
The area offers access to schools and childcare, as well as good transport connections to larger cities.
Requirements
We are looking for a candidate who:
Holds an EU-recognised qualification as a Radiographer
The profession must be regulated in the country of qualification
Currently working in an active clinical role as a radiographer
Full legal right to practise independently as a radiographer
Is interested in working with CT and conventional radiography
Enjoys working as part of a team and has as a professional and patient-centred approach
Has good communication skills in English
Is motivated to learn Swedish and adapt to the Swedish healthcare system
Is interested in establishing a long-term career and life in Sweden

 
Language and relocation
Swedish language training starts in your home country through individual online lessons with a private teacher. You study several hours per week alongside your current work.
Relocation to Sweden takes place once you have reached Swedish level B2.
After moving to Sweden, you begin working at 50% in a Radiography Assistant role while continuing your Swedish studies from B2 to C1.
Work and language training are combined during this period, with work in the mornings and Swedish studies in the afternoons, Monday to Friday.
The language education is provided and financed as part of the recruitment process.
You begin working fully as a radiographer once the required Swedish language level has been reached and Swedish professional authorization has been obtained.
Salary
During the language completion phase while employed as a Radiography Assistant, the salary is:
30,800 SEK/month gross
After obtaining Swedish authorization and beginning work as a Radiographer, the starting salary for a candidate without previous professional experience is:
31,100 SEK/month gross
The salary as an authorised radiographer may be individually determined depending on previous professional experience and competence.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
• Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
• Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
• Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
• Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype:
Application
Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis.
Please submit:
CV / résumé
Diploma and educational certificates
Proof of professional license/registration
Motivation letter
References from at least one manager and one professional colleague

Interested?
If you are a qualified radiographer interested in building a long-term career and life in Sweden, we would be happy to hear from you.
We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Permanent nursing positions in Jondal, Norway
jobs.description:
On behalf of Ullensvang Municipality, we are recruiting nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Jondal, Western Norway.
You will work across both nursing home and home care services, giving you the opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills. You will follow patients over time, make independent clinical assessments and work closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
Jondal is a small community in the Hardanger region on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. Here, you will live by the Hardangerfjord, surrounded by mountains, with Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, just 19 kilometres away.
Moving to another country is a big step, and we will support you throughout the process. Dignus Medical provides free Norwegian language training, assistance with Norwegian authorisation and practical support with relocation and settling into your new community.
About the position
As a nurse in Jondal, you will work with patients with different healthcare and care needs, both in a nursing home and in their own homes.
The role gives you a high degree of professional responsibility and the opportunity to follow patients over time, while working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
Your responsibilities will include:
Providing nursing care and following up patients
Clinical observation, assessment and documentation
Medication management and treatment
Providing care to patients in nursing homes and in their own homes
Making independent clinical assessments
Working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
Communicating with relatives and other parts of the healthcare service

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for qualified nurses who are confident in their professional role, comfortable working independently and motivated to build a new life and career in Norway.
You:
Hold a valid nursing licence from an EU/EEA country
Hold citizenship from an EU/EEA country
Speak English fluently and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian
Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language programme before starting work
Hold a valid driving licence
Work well both independently and as part of a team
Preferably have experience from community healthcare, nursing homes or home care services

We help you prepare for working in Norway
You do not need to speak Norwegian when you apply. If you are selected for the position, Dignus Medical will guide you through the entire process of preparing for your move to Norway.
We provide:
Free online Norwegian language training with a private teacher
Language training up to the required B2 level, including Norwegian for healthcare professionals
Assistance with your application for Norwegian nursing authorisation
Guidance with the documentation and administrative processes required before starting work
Help with finding accommodation and practical aspects of relocating to Norway
Personal follow-up before, during and after your move

The language training and authorisation process take place before you start working, so you have time to prepare both professionally and practically for your new life in Norway.
What you can expect in Jondal
A permanent position in the Norwegian municipal healthcare system
Varied work across nursing home and home care services
The opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills
Independent professional responsibility
Close cooperation with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
The opportunity to follow patients over time
Support with housing, relocation and practical arrangements

Life between the fjord, mountains and glacier
Jondal is located in Hardanger on Norway’s west coast, around 1 hour and 45 minutes from Bergen by car and ferry. It is a small community of around 400 people, situated directly by the Hardangerfjord and surrounded by mountains. Folgefonna, one of Norway’s largest glaciers, is only 19 kilometres away.
Nature is part of everyday life here. After work, you can hike in the mountains, kayak or fish on the fjord, or simply enjoy the quiet surroundings. In winter, the area offers excellent opportunities for skiing and other outdoor activities.
Despite its small size, Jondal has the essentials you need for everyday life, including a grocery store, places to eat and local cultural and leisure activities. If you are moving with your family, Jondal has both a kindergarten and a school for children from primary through lower secondary level, as well as a library, swimming pool and sports facilities. Odda is around 40 minutes away by car, while Bergen offers a larger city environment and an international airport.
Interested in starting a new chapter in Norway?
Feel free to get in touch for further information, or send us your application.

jobs.occupation: Permanent nursing positions in Utne, Norway
jobs.description:
On behalf of Ullensvang Municipality, we are recruiting nurses for permanent positions in municipal healthcare services in Utne, Western Norway.
As a nurse in Utne, you will work across both nursing home and home care services. You will meet patients with different healthcare needs, take independent professional responsibility and work closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals.
Utne is a small community in the Hardanger region on Norway’s west coast, around 2.5 hours from Bergen and Bergen International Airport. Located by the Sørfjord, a branch of the famous Hardangerfjord, Utne is surrounded by mountains, fruit orchards and some of Western Norway’s most characteristic scenery.
Moving to another country is a big step, and we will support you throughout the process. Dignus Medical provides free Norwegian language training, assistance with Norwegian authorisation and practical support with relocation and settling into your new community.
About the position
As a nurse in Utne, you will have a varied working day and the opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills. Some patients will be cared for in a nursing home, while others receive care in their own homes.
You will work independently and make professional assessments, while also being part of a team and working closely with other healthcare professionals.
Your responsibilities will include:
Providing nursing care and following up patients
Clinical observation, assessment and documentation
Medication management and treatment
Providing care to patients in nursing homes and in their own homes
Making independent clinical assessments
Working closely with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
Communicating with relatives and other parts of the healthcare service

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for qualified nurses who are confident in their professional role, comfortable working independently and motivated to build a new life and career in Norway.
You:
Hold a valid nursing licence from an EU/EEA country
Hold citizenship from an EU/EEA country
Speak English fluently and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian
Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language programme before starting work
Hold a valid driving licence
Work well both independently and as part of a team
Preferably have experience from community healthcare, nursing homes or home care services

We help you prepare for working in Norway
You do not need to speak Norwegian when you apply. If you are selected for the position, Dignus Medical will guide you through the entire process of preparing for your move to Norway.
We provide:
Free online Norwegian language training with a private teacher
Language training up to the required B2 level, including Norwegian for healthcare professionals
Assistance with your application for Norwegian nursing authorisation
Guidance with the documentation and administrative processes required before starting work
Help with finding accommodation and practical aspects of relocating to Norway
Personal follow-up before, during and after your move

The language training and authorisation process take place before you start working, so you have time to prepare both professionally and practically for your new life in Norway.
What you can expect in Utne
A permanent position in the Norwegian municipal healthcare system
Varied work across nursing home and home care services
The opportunity to use a broad range of your nursing skills
Independent professional responsibility
Close cooperation with colleagues and other healthcare professionals
The opportunity to follow patients over time
Support with housing, relocation and practical arrangements

Life in the heart of Hardanger
Utne is located by the Sørfjord in Hardanger on Norway’s west coast, surrounded by mountains and fruit orchards. Fruit growing has been part of life here for generations, and the landscape changes with the seasons, from orchards in full bloom in spring to apples, plums, pears and cherries later in the year.
Life here is quieter than in a large city, with the fjord and mountains right outside your door. You can spend your free time hiking, exploring the fjord or discovering local farms and producers. Utne also has a strong cultural heritage, including the Hardanger Folk Museum and the historic Utne Hotel.
If you are moving with your family, there is a kindergarten in Utne and a primary school with after-school care nearby. Odda, the main town and administrative centre of Ullensvang Municipality, is around 45 minutes away by car and offers a wider range of shops and services. Ferry connections link Utne to both sides of the fjord, making it easy to explore Hardanger and travel onwards towards Voss and Bergen. Bergen, the largest city in Western Norway, is around 2.5 hours away and has an international airport.
Interested in starting a new chapter in Norway?
Feel free to get in touch for further information, or send us your application.

Framtidens fordon – och en vinter du sent kommer glömma!❄️
Vill du vara en del av den senaste tekniken inom bilindustrin – på riktigt? Hos Tjintokk i vackra Slagnäs, Arjeplog (Lappland), får du chansen att vara med när ett av världens största bilmärken vintertestar sina allra nyaste bilmodeller. 🚘
Här testas fordon under extrema förhållanden – på noggrant preparerade banor både på land och is. Vårt uppdrag är att leverera högsta kvalitet och service på alla plan. Och just nu söker vi dig som vill bli en viktig del av det arbetet som lokalvårdare.
💫 Rollen som lokalvårdare – mer än bara städning
Som lokalvårdare är du med och ser till att våra miljöer – från hotellrum till verkstäder – håller absolut toppklass. Ditt arbete är en förutsättning för att både våra gäster och kollegor ska trivas och kunna prestera på högsta nivå.
Vi söker dig som:

Är noggrann och tar ansvar

Trivs i ett högt arbetstempo

Har lätt för att samarbeta och ta egna initiativ

Ser vad som behöver göras – och gör det med ett leende

Har ett öga för detaljer och förståelse för vikten av sekretess

Har erfarenhet av liknande arbetsuppgifter (meriterande)

Kan kommunicera obehindrat på engelska, eftersom vi har en internationell arbetsmiljö

🌟 Vad vi erbjuder dig
Hos Tjintokk blir du en del av ett varmt och engagerat team med kollegor från hela världen. Förutom ett meningsfullt arbete i en unik miljö får du tillgång till:

Prisvärda personalboenden för dig som kommer utifrån

Luncher och middagar till mycket förmånliga priser i vår egen restaurang

Fullutrustat gym, ishockeyrink och fina skidspår

Social gemenskap med aktiviteter och härlig sammanhållning

Vi rekryterar lokalvårdare till flera avdelningar:

Hotellrum

Allmänna ytor i hotell

Allmänna ytor i verkstäder (B-körkort krävs här)

🗓️ När?
Anställningar för vintersäsongen 2026/2027 sker löpande under oktober till december.
Kom som du är – bli en del av vår vinterfamilj
Hos oss på Tjintokk blir du en del av något större. Vi ser oss som en familj under den mörkaste tiden av året – och tillsammans skapar vi en ljus och minnesvärd säsong.
Välkommen att uppleva en riktig vinter – med oss! ❄️
The Vehicles of the Future – and a Winter You'll Never Forget! ❄️
Do you want to be part of the latest technology in the automotive industry – for real? At Tjintokk in beautiful Slagnäs, Arjeplog (Lapland), you'll have the chance to participate when one of the world's largest car brands winter-tests their newest vehicle models. 🚘
Here, vehicles are tested under extreme conditions – on carefully prepared tracks both on land and ice. Our mission is to deliver top-quality service on every level. And right now, we’re looking for someone like you to become a key part of that work as a cleaning staff member.
💫 The Role of a Housekeeper – More Than Just Cleaning
As a housekeeper, you help ensure that our environments – from hotel rooms to workshops – are kept in top condition. Your work is essential for both guests and colleagues to feel comfortable and perform at their best.
We’re looking for someone who:

Is thorough and takes responsibility

Thrives in a fast-paced work environment

Works well with others and takes initiative

Sees what needs to be done – and does it with a smile

Has an eye for detail and understands the importance of confidentiality

Has experience in similar roles (a plus)

Can communicate fluently in English, as we have an international work environment

🌟 What We Offer
At Tjintokk, you’ll be part of a warm and dedicated team with colleagues from all over the world. In addition to meaningful work in a unique environment, you’ll also get access to:

Affordable staff accommodation for those coming from outside the area

Lunches and dinners at great prices in our on-site restaurant

A fully equipped gym, ice hockey rink, and scenic ski trails

A social atmosphere with activities and strong team spirit

We are recruiting cleaners for several areas:

Hotel rooms

Common areas in the hotel

Common areas in the workshops (B driving license required for this position)

🗓️ When?
Hiring for the winter season 2026/2027 takes place continuously from October to December.
Come as you are – become part of our winter family
At Tjintokk, you’ll be part of something bigger. We see ourselves as a family during the darkest time of the year – and together, we create a bright and unforgettable season.
Welcome to experience a real winter – with us! ❄️
